name: cricket-auction
description: Multiplayer cricket auction game - build your dream squad in a live auction

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web "npm run start --workspace server" "npm run start --workspace web"
